sayLines.text: 🔭 Scouts come back pale. The sky looks wrong. Not cloudy, not dark — just... bigger. Like it's closer than it should be.
🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 8,4. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.

beatOmen2.text: ⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
Village meal: +2211 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
🩹 Lena makes rounds — Miguel gets bound up properly. (37 → 52 HP)
Lena came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
Marcelo had the day of their life — 1840 kcal. The pantry can't take it all: 920 kcal goes in, 920 kcal is eaten at the fire.
Liam: "Pedunculate Oak Acorn is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Liam and Stan lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Grace checks the pantry before heading out, then hangs back. "Shelves are full to bursting. Patching the boots today."
🍽️ Lena leaves the surplus by the fire for whoever's hungry. "The pantry can't take it. We can."
📓 Codex: Lena taught Miguel Wound Care.
